operationName: Operation Swords of Iron (Israel) / October 7 War
heroHeadline: Board of Peace Issues Hamas End-of-Week Disarmament Ultimatum; Won't Hold Israel to Ceasefire if Rejected — As Azzam al-Hayya Is Killed
heroSubtitle: The US-backed Board of Peace issued Hamas an end-of-week deadline to accept an 8-month phased disarmament framework, signaling it will not hold Israel to October 2025 ceasefire terms if Hamas refuses — effectively providing diplomatic cover for a return to full-scale war. Simultaneously, an Israeli airstrike killed Azzam al-Hayya, 32, son of Hamas chief ceasefire negotiator Khalil al-Hayya — the fourth son of his killed by Israel. The IDF's Southern Command presented a new operational war-resumption plan to Israel's political leadership. At least 8,000 bodies remain buried under Gaza rubble with only one functioning excavator available. Hamas rejected the disarmament framework as 'crude' and 'unacceptable,' insisting on a full Israeli withdrawal first. Gaza family discovers their 'martyred' son alive in Israel's Ofer Prison after 18 months of mourning, highlighting ~1,500 missing Palestinians believed held in Israeli detention. Cumulative toll: 72,591+ killed since Oct 7, 2023; 837+ killed since Oct 2025 ceasefire.
footerNote: Data sourced from IDF, Hamas, UN OCHA, UNRWA, WHO, ICJ, ICC, Times of Israel, Al Jazeera, The National, NPR, and Jerusalem Post. Gaza death toll: 72,591+ confirmed killed since Oct 7, 2023 (Gaza Ministry of Health / WAFA). 837+ killed since Oct 10, 2025 ceasefire framework as of May 8, 2026. Board of Peace issued Hamas end-of-week (May 9–10) disarmament ultimatum (May 8, 2026); signaled it will not hold Israel to ceasefire terms if Hamas refuses. Azzam al-Hayya (son of Hamas chief negotiator Khalil al-Hayya) killed by Israeli airstrike in Gaza City on May 7. IDF Southern Command presented war-resumption operational plan to political leadership. 8,000+ bodies remain under Gaza rubble; only 1 functioning ICRC excavator available (The National/ICRC, May 8). Hamas rejected disarmament framework as 'unacceptable' (May 2–8). Israel's orange line expansion (May 5–6) brought Israeli control to ~62% of Gaza; EU rejected the move. ICC arrest warrants for Netanyahu and Gallant (Nov 2024). Board of Peace $17B+ reconstruction fund frozen pending Hamas disarmament. 2026 Flash Appeal $4.1B req, only ~10% funded.
